markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (95%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Simulated frozen section with flagged reliability [F6], model disagreement, and deferred margins.

## Confidence
|Signal | Value | Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities | InSitu 95%, Normal 4%, Benign 1%, Invasive 1% [F1] | Strongly favors InSitu|
|Conformal set | {InSitu} (alpha 10%, 90% coverage) | Single-class 90% set|
|Reliability / OOD | 48% reliability (flagged), 76% OOD | Suspect input quality|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models conflict|
|Similar cases | 3/5 (60%) InSitu, 2/5 Normal [F5] | Mixed reference neighbors|

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable (-0.68 [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 0, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes down (-0.38 [F3]; 20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Duct-confined atypia** (regions 3, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Pushes down (-0.34 [F4]; 12/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Unreliable (+0.27; 0/20 AI spot check) · Unreliable
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 4, 8, 9) · context · 54% neoplastic (90th percentile), 0% epithelial [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in region 9 (42% risk), or low quality masks Normal (`BACH_0062`, 84% similar).
- Permanent margins are positive; superior, lateral, and inferior segments reach 100% probability (defer [F8]).

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 9**: Check for stromal invasion (42% risk, peak invasion score, 23 neoplastic nuclei).
2. **Regions 3, 5, 6**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus Normal (`BACH_0062` differs in `duct_confined`, `necrosis`).
3. **Regions 2, 3, 8, 9**: Inspect margins (up to 100% probability); consider drafted recut or deeper levels.
